thesis: The earnings catalyst is already priced in: the stock ran about 22% in 21 days, sits at the mean analyst target, and has RSI near 69 while the market is in a confident risk-off regime with QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages and the 10-year yield at a 1-year high percentile. The 3.7 R/R depends on a confirmed break of 124.62, and the first resistance offers only about 1.4R. Leverage is high (debt to equity about 410) in a rising-rate environment, and consumer demand into the holidays is exposed to record toy price inflation. A momentum name after a gap-up is vulnerable to mean reversion if the tape weakens further, and a close below 116.7 would break the post-earnings base.
